tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation still misses tolerance after several stationary branch fits. The principal unresolved feature is the sharp gradient-driven decline and sign reversal, so another high-gradient regime observation is the most discriminating remaining probe before revising the model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Two branch variants and a thresholded nonlinear leak have failed fresh confirmation; another fit without new discriminating data risks repeating the same miss.
The current failures concern the gradient response, not temporal dynamics; another trajectory batch at the same horizon is less targeted.
